products.name: Shinko 244 Dual Sport Tire
products.notes: DOT dual-sport (70% street / 30% dirt), 4-ply tube-type. Popular budget street-legal option for Sur-Ron-class bikes; 2.75-19 fits stock 19" rims. Stamped 'Golden Boy SR 244'. Picker price $59.46 at CCW does not match any current CCW variant ($53.51-$83.99) - flagged for re-check, price left as-is.

products.name: Kenda K270 Dual Sport Tire
products.notes: DOT dual-sport (50/50 street/dirt), tube-type. Huge size run from pit-bike to full-size; dedicated front and rear styles. Price varies by size. CCW also sells it at $59.99 (3.00x21 / 3.50x18, stock sizes).

products.name: Tusk Dsport Adventure Tire
products.notes: DOT aggressive dual-sport with tall knobbies (16mm rear / 11.5mm front tread depth). RM house brand. Sizes skew to full-size bikes; no small e-moto wheel sizes.

products.name: Kenda Millville II K785 Tire
products.notes: Soft-to-intermediate MX knobby with excellent pit-bike size coverage (12"/14"/16" rears). DOT-rated only in 21" front sizes; smaller sizes are NHS. Model K785 (not K778).

products.name: Shinko 525 Cheater Rear Tire
products.notes: Hybrid enduro rear: soft sticky trials-style rubber on a moto carcass for rocks/roots. Rear only, no front version. NHS (not for highway). Listed at MotoSport as R525 Cheater. CCW also sells it at $131.71 (110/100-18, stock rear size). Note: this is the R525, not the plain 525.

products.name: Dunlop Geomax MX34 Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX race tire with Progressive Cornering Block Technology. Very wide size run incl. minis (10"/12"/14"). Competition tire, no DOT approval. Price varies by size. CCW also sells it at $114.99 (80/100-21, stock front size).

products.name: Michelin StarCross 6 Medium Soft Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX tire with silica compound. Fronts 80/100-21, 90/100-21; rears 100/90-19 through 120/90-18. NHS. Full-size run only.

products.name: Pirelli Scorpion MX32 Mid Soft Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX tire with wide size run incl. minis. RevZilla flags this listing as discontinued (2025 MX32 update) — still purchasable in most sizes but stock thinning. No DOT approval.

products.name: Kenda K760 Trakmaster II Tire
products.notes: DOT-approved knobby (10% road / 90% off-road), 6-ply tube-type. Best small-wheel coverage of any DOT knobby: 10"/12"/14"/16"/17"/18"/19"/21". Pit-bike front/rear labeling varies by vendor — verify before ordering.

products.name: Bridgestone Battlecross X31 Tire
products.notes: Intermediate-terrain MX race tire: symmetric Castle Block front, asymmetric rear. Full-size run only, NHS (no DOT). Bridgestone mail-in rebate ($50/set) was active through Oct 31, 2026. CCW also sells it at $103.99 (80/100-21) / $110.99 (110/100-18).

products.name: Maxxis Maxxcross MX-SI Tire
products.notes: Soft/intermediate MX race tire (co-developed with Jeremy McGrath). Includes e-moto-relevant 90/100-14 rear and 70/100-17 front. NHS, no DOT approval.

products.name: IRC M5B EVO Soft Terrain Tire
products.notes: Rear-focused soft-terrain tire: giant self-cleaning knobs for mud/sand/loam, popular for hill climbs. Rear only (IRC makes a matching 80/100-21 front separately). NHS, not DOT.

products.name: Sur-Ron 19" Off-Road Tire (OEM)
products.notes: Official Sur-Ron OEM replacement knobby, 70/100-19. Page states it fits both front and rear Light Bee wheels. Listed at CAD $109.99 (~$79 USD); ships from Canada.

products.name: CST OEM Take-Off Tire 70/100-19

products.name: CST CM713 80/100-19 Rear Tire (Talaria OEM)
